title: Website and shopping-cart problems
required_reference_topics: Independent technical explanations and incident/report results, where available.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Distinguish site slowness, cart failures, search problems and a separately supported stock issue. Use relevant reported symptoms, already-tried steps and results before the next procedure-dependent step.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Distinguish site slowness, cart failures, search problems and a separately supported stock issue. Follow applicable troubleshooting steps and conditional escalation; do not invent a required browser fix. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Use relevant reported symptoms, already-tried steps and results before the next procedure-dependent step. Respect any documented troubleshooting order and obtain permission for a separately requested purchase.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise the actual error and later changes to its description. Respond to each failed attempt and any separate stock or purchase question.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for the fault as fixed, still present or unresolved using linked evidence; escalation is not proof of repair. Explain the actual remaining step or pending report and any supported follow-up.
check_conditions.communication-style: Give one understandable troubleshooting instruction at a time where sequencing matters.
check_conditions.answer-support: Approved troubleshooting guidance, documented service information and authoritative incident/report records.
